scope: CPU engineering replay of previously accepted saved records, no new TEST selection or inference
before_execution: Authenticate exact input paths/manifests from accepted handoff; original fixtures readonly
Pin both scorer closures/images; candidate functional/recovery review required
Use fresh output directories and fixed retained containers, no historical test discovery
Record host CPU availability, concurrent workload and filesystem/cache conditions; no disruptive cache flush
Freeze chosen workers/chunk_size before paired run; no use of science score for tuning

comparison.warmup: one bounded shared input read, measured separately; state exact cache limitations
comparison.acceptance: Every summary byte-identical; zero missing/duplicate questions, same required provenance checks. Report each pair and median rather than cherry-pick fastest.

instrumentation.clock: same-host monotonic for durations, UTC+boot_id for correlation
instrumentation.unknown: Keep uninstrumented phases null, not zero. Page-cache hits are not Ceph traffic.

followup: Only after baseline comparison optimize chunk-resume/hash reuse; rerun affected paired conditions and exact numerical equivalence; NPU timings separate after release prerequisites.
